isolated_client_replay.setup: Recovered 1.16.5.0 native client under Wine/Xvfb against copied auth, char and world databases. The copied character is the level-2 Alden checkpoint after DeSimone 1994/4 completion, starting at (390.5,119.55,160). A Docker-held network namespace gave the client and copied servers their own loopback and required queue port 8001 while the live service stayed on its existing ports. Auth account 2 password was reset only in the copied auth database.

observations.finding: Forean-like purple/green combatant appears near the camp player with orange companion overhead marker; the copy is still on objective 1994/2.
After ordinary forward movement into Hartmann sandbags, the marked companion is visible behind and to the left of the player.
After further player movement into the sandbag lanes, the marked companion has followed into the same lane, not stayed at the camp spawn.
The native target frame reads level 3 Forean Gunner Initiate with full health while the companion stands near the moving player.
After the player backtracks farther across the platform, the marked Gunner is again adjacent to the player with its weapon model visible.

server_log.finding: Isolated server loaded 407 content rows with zero gaps and accepted the copied client on the private boot-camp map.

limits: The Xvfb display ended before the player reached the courtyard. No companion attack, damage amount, survival comparison or cave trigger completion was observed in this replay.
The player took a diagnostic detour through Hartmann sandbags and back across the camp platform, not the filmed camp-to-cave route.
The body colour uses the emulator’s random creature colour packet; its visual hue is not established as final-live accurate.
This replay used a copied checkpoint after objective 4, so it does not verify mission acceptance or earlier travel.
isolated_client_replay.cleanup: The Wine client, copied auth/game servers, Xvfb and temporary network-namespace holder were stopped. The live Docker game remained on rasa-dit-test:20260923g and its databases were untouched by the replay.
